title: Apple TV has beloved comedy returning soon, with Pluribus star added - 9to5Mac
summary: Owen Wilson’s comedy Stick has a lot in common with Ted Lasso, and Apple just announced it’s returning soon for season 2—with Pluribus star Rhea Seehorn joining the cast. You can watch Stick season 1 here on Apple TV .
